summary: Pops the tail node of a render list and dispatches its rectangle. Reads the list head from this+0x14; when non-null and its node flag at +100 is set, it takes the tail node from this+0x18, unlinks it by writing the popped node's link at +104 into this+0x18, clears the flag at +100 of the new tail, dispatches GuardedSubRectangleRenderDispatch with the node's four fields at +4/+8/+0xC/+0x10, then zeroes the popped node's link fields at +100 and +104. Returns the original head value (or the dispatch result).

local_names.this: render list container holding head (this+0x14) and tail (this+0x18) pointers
local_names.result: list head read from this+0x14, carried to the return
local_names.v2: popped tail node read from this+0x18
local_names.v3: new tail, the link read from the popped node at +104

operations.description: List head read from this+0x14 into result; this is the value later returned
Pop proceeds only when the list head at this+0x14 is non-null
Pop proceeds only when the head node's flag at +100 is set, marking the list as having a tail to pop
Unlink: the popped node's link at +104 is written into this+0x18, making it the new tail
The new tail's flag at +100 is cleared
GuardedSubRectangleRenderDispatch invoked with the four fields at +4/+8/+0xC/+0x10 of the popped node, presumably rectangle position/size; result stored into result
Popped node's link fields at +100 and +104 are zeroed, detaching it from the list
Returns result: the head value read at entry, or the dispatch result once the pop executes
Invoked by ShortComputation_5b30 as the tail-pop step of a render-queue drain
